firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone,
I'm looking for one or two teammates who want to go for the prize range here, not just a medal. We are a team of two at 0.940 on the public LB. Our models are built quite differently from the public notebooks, so a merge should add real diversity to the ensemble.
What we bring:
- Our own label tables for all 4,407 training studies, built from the reports with structured fields per finding (location, compartment, grade) and refined with nested teacher models.
- Attention-MIL models (CoAtNet and ConvNeXt) on our own dense slice cache, a separate per-series model family, and an fp16 inference kernel with room for a large ensemble within the 9 hours.
- My track record: 2nd of 3,575 in Playground S6E9 and 13th of 3,947 in Biohub Cell Tracking (both with teams), and currently 18th of 10,246 in Kaggriculture.
What I'm looking for:
- Someone near the top of the board, or with a strong model that is built differently from ours.
- Real motivation to push until October 22.
- GPU capacity we can use as a team (H100/A100 class or a multi-GPU machine), with weights and predictions shared inside the team. Right now compute is our bottleneck, not ideas.
If you're interested, contact me. (Discord or email).
Thanks!
